name: To Find A Home
source:
Congratulations, you have just been evicted! Nowhere to sleep tonight? Here, just follow this ad's directions - don't worry, the vampire won't bite... not unless you ask them to. Worry about the house instead.

Enter the 137 Moonlit Avenue - all guests welcome!

Flirt, banter and argue with your new roommates. Get judged by the snarky, dandy ghost. Meet the demon cat. Untangle the haunted house's curse. Feed the poor, starved vampire, get wild with the werewolf or have a sweet heart-to-heart with the witch. 

[From [url=https://ravenmythinteractive.itch.io/to-find-a-home]itch.io[/url]]
